claims.text: The Bank of America 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (published 2026-07-31) states that GWIM consists of two primary businesses, Merrill Wealth Management and Bank of America Private Bank. The profit and margin figures it gives are for GWIM as a whole.

adjacent.text: The 3Q26 earnings press release (published 2026-10-14) gives GWIM pretax income of $2,053 million, net income of $1,540 million and a pretax margin of 29%. Pretax income for 2Q26 was $1,884 million and for 3Q25 it was $1,686 million.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

adjacent.text: The 3Q26 supplement (published 2026-10-14) gives Merrill Wealth Management revenue of $5,905 million, against $1,213 million for Bank of America Private Bank and $7,118 million for GWIM in total.
adjacent.differs_because: This is revenue for Merrill Wealth Management only. It is not pre-tax profit or margin, and no profit or margin is given for Merrill alone.

adjacent.text: The 2Q26 earnings press release (published 2026-07-14) gives GWIM pretax income of $1,884 million and a pretax margin of 27%, compared with 22% in 2Q25.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

adjacent.text: The 1Q26 earnings press release (published 2026-04-15) gives GWIM pretax income of $1,772 million and a pretax margin of 26%, compared with 22% in 1Q25.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

adjacent.text: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-25) states that GWIM net income rose $407 million to $4.7 billion and that the operating margin was 25 percent in both 2025 and 2024.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

gaps.what: Merrill does not report standalone results. The evidence gives no pre-tax profit or pre-tax margin for Merrill Wealth Management alone. Bank of America discloses revenue and client balances by business, but pre-tax income and margin only for GWIM as a whole.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America 10-K or 10-Q segment disclosure, or the quarterly earnings supplement. Bank of America would need to begin reporting Merrill Wealth Management profit separately.
